bio: Having once played host to Henry VIII, New Hall Hotel is the perfect backdrop to experience a tradition made famous by the royal household. Combining majestic surroundings, exceptional service and delicious handmade food, you can be sure of a memorable Afternoon Tea in Birmingham.  Afternoon Tea at New Hall Hotel & Spa is served in the Bridge Restaurant, with beautiful views over the gardens and grounds. In warmer months, you can also enjoy Afternoon Tea alfresco. The elegant yet relaxed setting makes it the perfect spot to unwind and indulge in this British tradition.  The Afternoon Tea menu features an array of savoury treats, scones and sweet pastries, along with a wide selection of loose-leaf teas. The talented pastry chefs prepare the scones and cakes freshly each day. The menu is refreshed regularly to celebrate various occasions throughout the year.  New Hall Hotel are also able to cater to a wide range of dietary requirements including gluten-free, vegan and have special children's Afternoon Tea options. Why not upgrade your traditional experience with a glass of Champagne or Prosecco for the height of luxury?
